name: 可调和中遮瑕裸感粉底液款
description: 泵头量取、可叠加中等遮瑕、半脸妆效对照与色阶选色的底妆套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF packshot field, pale studio paper #EFEBE5 for face-comparison and closing screens, sand-caramel liquid smear field #DDB483 for benefit screens, cool greige skin panel #D8D2CB and concrete grey board #C9C3BC for swatch and pain screens, warm taupe gradient #6E5F55 for portrait scenes, deep espresso #43291C bands and closing trust panel
styleLock.lightingSystem: large front-left softbox key with a bounce fill, 5400K, soft contact shadows, controlled speculars on glass and pump collar, identical clamshell beauty light on every face panel, skimming low-incidence light only for texture macro
styleLock.surfaceSystem: glossy liquid smear film #DDB483, brushed perspex sheet #EDEBE8 with a soft mirror reflection, matte greige board #C9C3BC
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; every headline band, pill label and seal is drawn as an empty outline frame so no wording is generated in-image
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line icons and blank circular seal outlines in deep espresso #43291C only
styleLock.presentationRules: the product keeps one slight 3/4 or straight-on angle and one consistent scale across the set; all faces are generic models lit and cropped identically and never tied to a source likeness; shade range is shown as graded strokes, never as codes
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting between comparison panels
no invented badges, percentages or test figures
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent inclusive editorial base-makeup commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white studio field #FFFFFF, sand-caramel liquid texture field #DDB483, cool greige skin panel #D8D2CB and deep espresso graphic band #43291C with charcoal text #2B2320; neutral studio lighting from a large front-left softbox with bounce fill at 5400K, soft contact shadows and controlled speculars; modern geometric sans-serif; single-weight thin-line icons and empty pill and seal outline frames only; glossy liquid smear surfaces and brushed perspex used sparingly; stable slight 3/4 product angle and consistent product scale; identical light and crop across every comparison panel; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no model likeness drift, no invented badges or figures.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用去盖露泵的正身白底图抢首图位
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, bottle standing upright, removed overcap resting to the lower right, full product inside the frame
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, large front-left softbox key with bounce card, soft contact shadow under both pieces, controlled speculars on the glass shoulder
shots.whitespace: none, even margin on all four sides
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle stands upright at a straight-on eye-level angle with its removed overcap resting to the lower right, the full product inside the frame and an even margin all around. Bright even high-key studio lighting from a large front-left softbox with a bounce card on the shadow side, soft contact shadows grounding both pieces, controlled speculars along the glass shoulder and the pump collar. Seamless white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace. 8K commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no added text overlays, no extra logos, no shade-code chips, no hands, no props other than the overcap, no tinted or gradient background, no cut-off edges, no floating product without a contact shadow, no watermark.

shots.displayName: 双支卧入膏体抹痕卖点

shots.lighting: sweeping soft top light from the upper left, wet highlights riding the ridges of the smear, no hard edge
shots.background: sand-caramel liquid smear field #DDB483 fading to pale studio paper #EFEBE5
shots.props: one broad glossy smear of the same fluid plus two empty pill-shaped outline label frames
shots.whitespace: generous negative space kept across the upper left third

shots.intent: 放大普通底妆斑驳、卡纹、遮不住的日常挫败感
shots.camera: matched split screen shot from a slight low angle; left panel is an extreme close-up macro with a tight zoom across cheek and jawline, right panel straight-on
shots.lighting: left panel flat harsh frontal light with no falloff; right panel soft front-left key with a gentle wrap
shots.background: cool greige skin panel #D8D2CB on both panels
shots.whitespace: none, the two states fill the frame
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels kept at the same slight low camera height. Left panel: an extreme close-up macro, tight zoom across a generic cheek and jawline where an ordinary liquid base has separated into patchy streaks and gathered in skin texture, lit flat and harsh from the front with no falloff. Right panel: {product} standing on the same plane in a soft front-left key as the way out. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background cool greige skin panel #D8D2CB on both panels with a clean hairline divider. Each panel carries its subject at 40-50% with no extra whitespace. Negative: no recognisable model identity, no competitor packaging on the left panel, no skin-disease or wound imagery, no invented statistics or survey figures, no readable text, no watermark, no deformed facial features.

shots.props: one empty rounded swatch-stroke outline frame at the top left
shots.whitespace: clean margin kept around the crown and shoulders
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce before-and-after comparison for {product}, one face split down the centre by a fine vertical line, both halves framed identically from a straight-on symmetrical frontal angle at the same distance and crop. Left half bare skin with visible redness and uneven tone; right half the same face wearing the fluid for an even skin-like medium finish with pores still readable. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Generic adult model with no source likeness, hair dressed back, neutral expression. Identical clamshell beauty light on both halves with a butterfly key above the nose bridge and no shadow shift. Background pale studio paper #EFEBE5. An empty rounded swatch-stroke outline frame sits at the top left. The face occupies 50-60% of the frame with clean margin around the crown. Negative: no celebrity or source model likeness, no letter-and-number shade codes inside the swatch frame, no plastic over-retouched skin, no colour or exposure shift between the two halves, no misaligned framing, no watermark, no added text.

shots.intent: 让不同肤色的买家把自己代入，建立拥有感

shots.intent: 用一整片膏体微距证明延展度与细腻颗粒

shots.intent: 把多重妆效主张拆成四组同光同框对照，批量给证据

shots.props: four blank label bars drawn as empty outlines
shots.whitespace: hairline gutters only between the four panels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce proof-matrix infographic for {product}: a two-by-two grid of four matched half-face before-and-after panels, every panel shot from the identical straight-on frontal angle at the identical distance and cropped at the identical line, each featuring a different generic skin depth with no source likeness. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Negative: no readable words in the band or the label bars, no invented clinical or survey numbers, no lighting mismatch between panels, no duplicated face, no plastic over-retouched skin, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 去盖露泵正身白底棚拍；002 与 001 同构图，仅右上加一枚高饱和圆形媒体背书章；003 单脸左右半分屏，左上一枚色号抹痕条加底部两枚英文单词；004 两支卧于大片亮光膏体抹痕上，配两枚胶囊标签框与三段说明文字；005 模特以指持瓶贴颊的近景肖像，暖棕到浅灰渐变棚纸加顶部两行大标题；006 二乘二四组同光同框半脸分屏，顶部深色标题带加四段黑底标签；007 三乘三九张正脸肖像矩阵，顶部肤色带与每格字母数字标号；008 名人式正面肖像，超大百分比数字加胶囊标签与极小字脚注；009 极近距离一片膏体抹痕铺满画面，中央叠三层字；010 四件同系列底妆单品并排于镜面板上，顶部两行标题。品类判定依据：主产品为泵头瓶装液体底妆，全部画面围绕上脸妆效与色阶选择，非着色彩妆盘亦非护理品，故取美妆彩妆/底妆，与源类目路径一致；010 出现遮瑕、粉饼、腮红等同系列件，仅作连带陈列，主产品仍唯一，故不判混合套装。变体闸门：仅 001 与 002 为同构图，其余各镜分镜不同，非色卡画廊，正常转化。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与系列名、店铺与注册符号、全部字母数字色号与肤色标号、媒体圆章与其刊名、名人肖像身份、超大百分比与样本量脚注、成分名与浓度数字、容量与时长数字、原始英文文案原句；模特一律改写为无身份的 generic model，质地与选色信息改为空抹痕与空标签框，信任信息改为空印章框与空数字块。
